context.transcript:
On July 5th, the town of Pennington will host its annual music festival in Maple Park, and the organizers are seeking volunteers from our community to help make the event a success.
On June 12th, there will be auditions for local musicians at the town recreation center.
The organizers would like you to help select which acts will perform on stage.
If you're interested in helping out, please email musicfest at mymail. com with your name and phone number.
context.transcript_translation:
7月5日，彭宁顿镇将在枫叶公园举办一年一度的音乐节，组织者正在社区招募志愿者以帮助活动取得成功。
6月12日，镇娱乐中心将举行本地音乐家的试音。
组织者希望您能帮忙挑选哪些表演节目要在舞台上进行。
如果您有兴趣帮忙，请发送邮件至 musicfest at mymail. com，并附上您的姓名和电话号码。
